title: The Escape from Ignorance
paragraphs: "Ah, yeah... Um, don't worry about it. The ringleader got what was coming to him, after all..."

The conversation between my Finacée and Father seems a bit awkward. This... feels a lot like the atmosphere when I persuaded Ren and Itsuki to go to Faubrey. In other words, it’s highly unlikely that Father will be swayed by my Finacée!
“Father! Do your best to kick that guy out!”
Here’s my suggestion! It’s not too late yet! My Finacée has only just started getting along with Sakura-chan. If we act now, we should still be able to turn this around!
“Motoyasu, that’s really rude.”
Father furrowed his brow and scolded me. But Father, if things keep going like this, Sakura-chan will end up falling under the Finacée’s spell.
“Um… what does Second Princess Melty think of Sakura-chan and the others?”
“Um…”
My Finacée lowered her gaze and looked at Sakura-chan.
“These kids, you see, are actually monsters called Filolials. They’ve been a huge help to us, and they’re strong enough to be relied upon.”
“Yes… just a moment ago, they gave me a ride on their backs.”

What?! When did she get on there?! I refuse to accept that my Finacée and Sakura-chan are bound by the red thread of fate! I refuse to accept ittttttttttt! Perhaps sensing my Ki, my future Father calls out to me, giving me a second look, then—for some reason, breaking out in a sweat—calls out to my Finacée.
“So please be very careful.”
“Naofumi Sakura, I want to play with Mel-chan more!”
“Hmm… If Second Princess Melty is okay with it?”
“Y-yes! I want to play with Sakura-chan and the others, too!”
Seizing the moment, my Finacée agreed. Time to back off.
“Well then… as long as you don’t stray too far… I’d like you to play with her until I’ve finished speaking with Her Majesty… Princess, would you mind?”

Father backed down! I want him to forcefully separate me from Sakura-chan! I want him to refuse just like he did last time. But… for some reason, even last time, Father let Filo-tan get along with my Finacée.
“Yes!”
“Also… about my older sister, I’m sorry… you must be holding a grudge, right?”

“Um… my older sister is still alive (on paper), so the one who was defeated by the Heroes was a criminal who tried to overthrow the kingdom. Please don’t worry about it. Well… there are all sorts of things going on regarding which of us will succeed as the next queen…”

Motoyasu Ear didn’t miss what the Finacée muttered under her breath! I can tell from the bottom of my heart that she doesn’t care one bit about Crimson Swine’s life or death! Well, from what I’ve heard, she was apparently up to all sorts of things without Trash noticing. Crimson Swine is the absolute lowest of the low even among pigs, so I suppose it can’t be helped.
“The Shield Hero need not worry about our country. Please… take your time and enjoy your visit to Melromarc.”
“Yeah, take care. Well then… Sakura-chan and the others, get along well with Second Princess Melty.”
“Okay!”
“Understood.”
“Yay!”
Sakura-chan and the others, led by Filolial-sama, started playing with their Finacées. Grrr! That’s just how it is!
“…I finally get why Motoyasu-kun was so determined to have Sakura-chan stay behind.”
Father narrowed his eyes and walked over to me. He understood, so why wouldn’t he listen to me!? I just don’t get what Father is thinking.
“Father! Why is that?! Why did you allow Sakura-chan and that guy to hang out together?”
“Motoyasu-kun, that girl… she’s probably going to become best friends with that girl named Filo, right? They’re becoming close at an incredible pace, and it’s not dangerous, is it?”
“It’s dangerous! That guy… and Sakura-chan are the same gender! It’s unhealthy!”
I just want Filo-tan to be healthy. It’s not that I’m trying to rule out the possibility of being with her just for my own selfish reasons. I’m telling the truth!
“…Sigh.”
“That ‘Spear Hero’… is such an idiot, isn’t he?”
“Larsa… shh!”
The panda and the elephant are giving me pitying looks as if this were their chance! What’s with that!?
“So that’s how it is… Still, a Finacée…”
“Father actually approved it!”
“I guess there must have been a reason he had to.”
“It’s an unhealthy relationship!”
“With that Second Princess, it’s clearly nothing more than friendship, no matter how you look at it. They seem to be having fun, so let’s just watch over them, Motoyasu-kun.”
“Guh… Sakura-chan! You can’t do that!”
My cry echoed throughout the area.
Soon, Éclair—looking thoroughly exasperated—arrived to escort me to my audience with the Queen.
“Lord Kitamura’s voice was echoing throughout the castle.”
“Ah… I’m sorry, Ms. Eclair.”
“No, on the contrary, I was relieved… Lord Iwatani, it’s good to see you’re still your usual self.”
“Yeah.”
“Well then, the Queen is waiting. The Shield Hero and Spear Hero, and everyone from Siltvelt, this way.”

With that, Éclair began to lead the way. Of course, my Finacée seemed to have waved to Sakura-chan and the others the moment Éclair arrived and headed off ahead. Guided by Éclair, we were led into the throne room where the queen awaited. The queen was already seated on her throne.
“Welcome… I am Queen Mirellia Q Melromarc, ruler of Melromarc. It’s a pleasure to meet you all.”
“Um… this is the second time I’ve had to introduce myself here. I’m Naofumi Iwatani, summoned as the Shield Hero.”
“I’m Motoyasu Kitamura, The Love Hunter!”
“Motoyasu-kun… Well, since she probably knows who you are anyway, I guess it’s fine…”
We introduced ourselves as representatives. The people from Siltvelt introduced themselves afterward as well—it’s just a formality, I suppose.
“On behalf of my country, I apologize for the immense trouble caused to the Shield Hero and the Spear Hero, as well as everyone from Siltvelt, due to the rampage of extremists in Melromarc.”
The queen said that and bowed her head slightly. Yeah, yeah—as expected, the queen really does have a virtuous heart.
“No… We were able to travel to Siltvelt without incident, and now that the ringleaders have been dealt with, I don’t think there’s a future for either side if we let this grudge linger.”
“We are grateful for the Shield Hero’s mercy. So… what brings you to our country on this visit?”

After some small talk, the queen will ask us about our purpose. By the way, the people of Siltvelt all seem a bit wary. Well, she is, after all, the Queen known as the “She-Fox of Melromarc.” I suppose they assumed there was something ulterior going on. From the Queen’s perspective, it’s hard to imagine that Father harbors any warm feelings toward Melromarc, so I suppose it can’t be helped.

“Um… regarding this visit, I came because I realized there were essential matters I needed to attend to in Melromarc in order to resolve the issue concerning the remnants of the faction led by Takt, the felon who deceived the Hero in Faubrey.”

Father is going to explain the issue regarding the remnants of Takt’s faction to the Queen. However, he won’t mention that the purpose is to gain support in Shieldfreeden. I suppose it’s so she won’t see it as an opening to exploit?

“Furthermore, as an ally, we wish to assist Melromarc—which is currently facing the threat of the Waves without its Bow Hero and Sword Hero—as a friendly force. Accordingly, we would like to request the right to move freely within the country.”

“I see… Very well. It is Melromarc’s duty to cooperate so that the Heroes may act freely to overcome this global crisis. We grant full permission for your activities within our borders and will provide assistance. Please let us know at any time if there is anything you need.”
“Thank you.”
As expected, the Queen gets straight to the point. It really ought to go this smoothly. Shieldfreeden could learn a thing or two from her.

“And… let’s leave the formalities at that for now. There is a matter I’m not normally at liberty to discuss, but it’s one that could ultimately cause significant trouble for you, the Heroes, and indeed everyone in Siltvelt. I would be grateful if you would listen to what I have to say.”

The Queen raised her fan to signal, and some of the soldiers and ministers left the room as the doors were closed. A private conversation, I suppose. The people of Siltvelt went on high alert. Don’t worry. Even if the Queen were to do something, I’ll wipe it all out.
“Should we be on guard against anyone lurking in the shadows as well?”
“Yes… We’re about to discuss matters that would be extremely problematic if overheard. Everyone, please be very careful…”
“Then I’ll cast Magic to flush out any hidden intruders. If you’re working for the Queen, reveal yourselves or get out of here.”
“Go ahead.”

At the Queen’s word, I’ll cast the Liberation Fireflash spell. This will make it impossible to hide and eavesdrop. While it’s not impossible that there are bugs or the like, I should be able to spot any devices planted in a place like this right away.
“So, is there a problem with that?”

“Yes… Actually, an imposter claiming to be the Wise King of Wisdom—who had been arrested by Knight Eclair and imprisoned—has escaped with the help of an unknown accomplice. We are currently dispatching a pursuit team in secret.”
The Queen speaks with a slight sigh. Trash escaped? Honestly, what on earth is everyone up to?
“That means… in other words…”

“Yes. It means someone posing as the Wise King of Wisdom is lying low somewhere, biding their time… Regarding this matter, I am addressing it as a scandal so shameful it brings disgrace upon you, the Heroes—this is my judgment as Queen. Please be on your guard.”
“That’s incredibly sloppy… Did you let him escape on purpose?”
“I have no words to respond.”

Indeed. It really is a blunder so grave I’m at a loss for words. However, considering the loops we’ve been through so far, I can’t imagine the Queen making such a basic mistake. It would be more natural to assume there’s a reason behind it.
“The circumstances seem too convenient… With all due respect, may I ask what the reason is?”
Father, having also noticed something, asked the Queen.

“Of course. One of the nation’s finest knights, who was on guard duty, was killed without even having a chance to defend himself. It appears a coordinated attack was carried out specifically to let the impostor ‘Wise King of Wisdom’ escape.”

As she spoke, a young nobleman—who had remained behind at the Queen’s instruction—handed us some documents. To make it easier to understand, illustrations of the crime scene and a video crystal were displayed. With practiced ease, he pointed out the corpse of the knight who’d been stabbed through with a sword and the broken-into tower where he’d been imprisoned… the very tower where Trash had been locked away. That rings a bell. In other words, Trash escaped with the help of someone.
Father examined the documents and footage, then fell deep in thought for a while.

“The impostor posing as the Wise King of Wisdom… has been repeating phrases like, ‘Before I’m imprisoned, I’ll avenge the adventurer Myne, who was executed by the Spear Hero!’ along with a barrage of insults and abuse. As things stand, there’s a real risk he’ll cause even more trouble for the Heroes.”
“That’s…”
“It’s anyone’s guess just how capable this impostor—who’s now taken on the role of the Wise King of Wisdom in earnest—will be… Please exercise the utmost caution.”
So, Trash who’s gotten serious is racking his brains to take revenge on us? HAHAHA! No matter how much Trash he is, that’s impossible.

“To address this issue, Melromarc has decided to dispatch Knight Eclair—who made a tremendous contribution during this recent upheaval as an escort for the Shield Heroes and Spear Heroes—as their bodyguard. I can only pray that you will accept him.”
Following the Queen’s orders, Éclair steps forward, salutes, and bows his head.
“O-okay. We’ve definitely received Melromarc’s decision.”
“Once again, I count on you. Lord Iwatani, Lord Kitamura.”

In other words, Éclair has been officially dispatched as Father’s bodyguard to resolve the issue of Trash’s escape. Well, I suppose Éclair is fine, isn’t he? It wouldn’t look very good if we only had huge pandas and elephants around.
“Is there anything else… you’d like to request of Melromarc?”
“In that case, I’d like to register with the Dragon Hourglass in preparation for the next wave.”
“Understood. Please escort the Heroes to the Dragon Hourglass. Knight Eclair will handle the funds for your activities within the kingdom.”
“Yes. Thank you very much. As for the rest…”
Father glanced briefly in my direction and toward Sakura-chan and the others.

“Before the audience, I had the opportunity to meet this country’s Second Princess, and it seems she spent a very meaningful time with the children who are part of our group. If the opportunity arises again, would you mind letting them play with her?”
Father, why are you being so considerate!? The Queen nodded as if she understood after hearing the details from her subordinates.
“Understood. As long as you, the Heroes, remain in the castle, I fully grant permission for you to interact with our Second Princess. Please foster this friendship.”
“Thank you.”

I feel like my Finacée’s expression—who had been silently watching the proceedings from the throne room—has brightened slightly. Sakura-chan and the others are waving at my Finacée, too. It really feels like they’re saying, “We’re friends!”
No, no, no! Unhealthy relationships are absolutely out of the question!
But the voice of my inner thoughts, crying out like this, failed to echo through the room… and so, the audience with the Queen concluded without a hitch.
